request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Add two small round powder kegs on the deck at the front, painted with bold diagonal black and hazard yellow (#fdd20f) stripes; a short dark fuse sticks out of the front keg, lit with a small bright yellow-white spark. Do not redraw anything else: keep the hull, tin patches, mast, sail, rocket, goblin, colours, thick black outline and style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
